images.corrections_before_publication: Retain proxy and backend VotingPlugin installations. Replace broad storage/reward wording and the all-servers tagline with configuration-dependent routing. Do not present reward definitions as automatically shared by SQL.

Replace the unconditional immediate-delivery wording. A usable player connection permits transport, but routing, voter state, WaitForUserOnline, and reward settings can still delay delivery. The connection carrying the message need not belong to the voter.

Remove the Redis-to-SQL connection drawn in the image; the VotingPlugin instances access SQL separately. Replace unconditional all-backend delivery with eligible destination(s) selected by configuration.

Show both proxy and backend listener/address roles, not only proxy-initiated connections. Remove the suggestion that the shared SOCKETS key is optional. Prefer reachable private example addresses and retain firewall restrictions; distinguish these ports from Votifier ingress.

Add the documented development-build qualification, explicitly exclude VotingPlugin from regional/player-facing proxies, show backend presence reporting, and remove the unexplained regional-to-dedicated connection. Do not claim a measured performance benefit.
